title: Hardware Procurement Fulfilment, Final Invoice and Order Closing
content:
Hardware Procurement orders ship by the order type's shipping method, with a signature on delivery where the order type requires one, and in partial lots only where the order type allows partial shipment. The delivery target in business days is a target for in-stock items, not a guarantee.

**Final invoice.** On delivery of the whole order the final invoice bills the quote total minus any deposit invoiced, due the order type's invoice terms in calendar days later.

**Closing.** The order closes on the day after the later of the end of its return window and the end of its dead-on-arrival window, provided nothing is owed on it.

| Hypothetical order | Quote total | Deposit invoiced | Final invoice on full delivery |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 12000.00 | 6000.00 | 6000.00 |
| B | 4000.00 | none | 4000.00 |

**Closing, worked through (hypothetical).** For an order whose return window ends on one day and whose dead-on-arrival window ends fifteen days later, the later of the two ends is the end of the dead-on-arrival window, so the order closes on the day after that end, provided nothing is owed on it. Where the return window is the one that ends later, the order closes on the day after the return window ends. An order with a balance still owing does not close on that day.

**Partial lots.** Where an order ships in lots, the final invoice waits for delivery of the whole order.
